title: The real L2 contraction of a finite invariant Markov kernel
source_anchor: Derived standard finite-invariant-Markov-kernel real-L2 theorem, using pinned Mathlibdb584cd6 kernel/compProd/L2/adjoint definitions. PBPS arXiv2609.06905v1 A.2(A.9) and B.1 are motivating actual consumers, NOT a claim that this source-neutral premise bundle is the paper theorem.
target_statement: One continuous real-linear L2 contraction realizes raw kernel integration for every MemLp representative, with AE fiber integrability, AE order positivity, fixed one, preserved genuine mean, and self-adjointness conditional on reversibility.
consumers: PBPS A.2: actual retained-y half-turn operator on L2(J), after exact conditional reversible lift; all-L2 representative/integrability/self-adjoint/Markov assertions remain open until actual adapter compiles.
PBPS B.1: actual one-step K on L2(J) using VERIFIED actual K.Invariant J from PR329. K need not be reversible; no claim its operator is self-adjoint.
